headline: Sumeet Industries files AGM voting results and scrutinizer report
hook: Sumeet Industries concludes annual shareholder voting
summary: Sumeet Industries has submitted the official scrutinizer's report following its Annual General Meeting held on September 29, 2026. The filing includes the formal voting results for the 2025-26 financial year. This is a routine regulatory compliance filing for the company.
why_it_matters: Routine regulatory filing with no immediate impact on share price.
